attempts.rationale: Failure is slip at 10.16kg with 100N grip. Weight ~100N requires ~62N per side statically (m*g/(2*mu)), so 100N has no margin for inertial loads during transport. Fix: increase close_gripper to 300N for safety factor ~3, slow down loaded moves (150-200 steps) to reduce acceleration, lift higher (0.25) and place from 0.06 to set down gently without pushing, plus dwell after close to secure grasp.
